steps.en: Install the app, grant Screen Recording + Accessibility permission
steps.zh: 装好应用，授予屏幕录制与辅助功能权限

steps.en: Pick the window or screen to record, then just do the demo
steps.zh: 选定要录的窗口或整屏，然后照常演示

steps.en: Native helper captures screen, system audio, mic, webcam and cursor events
steps.zh: 原生采集层抓下画面、系统声音、麦克风、摄像头与光标事件

steps.en: Auto-zooms follow the cursor; cursor path is smoothed and clicks animated
steps.zh: 自动缩放跟随光标，光标轨迹被抹平，点击自带动画

steps.en: Trim on the timeline, set per-segment speed, add text/arrow annotations
steps.zh: 在时间线上修剪、逐段调速，加文字和箭头标注

steps.en: Export MP4 or GIF in the aspect ratio you need
steps.zh: 按需要的画面比例导出 MP4 或 GIF

value.en: A polished, zoom-following demo from one free local recording pass — no subscription, no watermark
value.zh: 一次本地免费录制就得到自动缩放的成品演示——无订阅、无水印

sources: README Installation (brew install --cask siddharthvaddem/openscreen/openscreen; macOS Screen Recording + Accessibility permissions; winget/installers for Windows and Linux)
README Core Features (auto zooms that follow the cursor, cursor smoothing and click effects, backgrounds, per-segment speed, MP4/GIF export in multiple aspect ratios)
README Platform differences (macOS ScreenCaptureKit / Windows Graphics Capture native pipelines; Linux browser pipeline)
